scope: Direct engineering/anatomical plausibility inspection of all 56 final native paired anchors and 49 complete measured source rasters. Not clinical validation or a browser review.
inspectionMethod: All 56 pairs and 49 source rasters were directly reviewed in the first final export. After three material target changes, the AV, AV-zoom and deep-TG pairs and complete source rasters were opened separately at native size. All other 53 pairs and available source rasters are byte-identical to the directly inspected first-final evidence. The current source sheets are bound to the current export.

views.observedAnatomy: Longitudinal thick LV wall and narrow trabecular cavity; basal chamber/outflow lumens to the right. Same cardiac section family as PLAX.
views.qualification: Gross long-axis topology supported. A deep pleural/pericardial survey is not supplied by this isolated-heart scan.

views.observedAnatomy: Long LV region, slit-like cavity, basal inflow/outflow channels and several lumens.
views.qualification: Gross long-axis topology supported; leaflet identity and normal opening are not established.

views.observedAnatomy: A smaller crop of the same basal/outflow region; a bright bordered lumen and adjacent narrow channel are visible.
views.qualification: Target unconfirmed: source ROI is magnified, but AV cusps{local-home} identity needs independent landmarks. The 3D camera still includes the retained heart.

views.observedAnatomy: LV cavity approaches the basal atrioventricular region; thin bright internal structures are visible in the crop.
views.qualification: Target unconfirmed: an inflow-region crop is present, but individual MV leaflets/chordae cannot be certified.

views.observedAnatomy: A long tube-like basal lumen with internal thin tissue, neighboring chamber spaces, and a ventricular wall/cavity below.
views.qualification: Target unconfirmed: an outflow-like longitudinal structure is present, but the RVOT–PV–PA chain is not independently identified.
views.baselineComparison: Same plane; sampling dimension changed by one pixel

views.observedAnatomy: Large thin-walled/trabeculated chamber spaces beside a thick LV wall wedge; an angled inlet region crosses the middle.
views.qualification: Gross right-heart inflow-like topology supported; TV leaflet identity remains unconfirmed.
views.baselineComparison: Same plane; sampling dimension changed by one pixel

views.observedAnatomy: Basal short-axis section with a central trilobed semilunar-root-like structure and surrounding right-heart/basal lumens.
views.qualification: Broad basal{local-home} topology supported. This clear root cross-section provided an independent source comparator for the corrected AV-specific presets; individual cusp identity remains unconfirmed.

views.observedAnatomy: Basal short-axis section with a distinct three-lobed semilunar-root region, thin internal tissue profiles and surrounding right-heart/basal lumens. Both anchors retain the same source-preserved section and illustrative skin contact.
views.qualification: Regional aortic-root/valve-level topology supported by independent reviewed source landmarks. The selected plane is 3 mm from the reviewed cusp-region ROI center and 0.36 mm from the independent proximal aortic-lumen point. Individual cusp names, exact annular dimensions and clinical probe registration remain unvalidated.
views.baselineComparison: Material correction: the prior oblique C-shaped basal/LVOT section is replaced by the source-preserving reviewed-root plane at +3 mm.

views.observedAnatomy: Tighter crop of the identical AV source plane, clearly retaining the three-lobed root region and fine internal profiles. The anatomy camera still shows the retained heart.
views.qualification: Regional root topology supported. Zoom changes only the crop; center and plane basis are identical to psax_av. Individual cusp identity and clinical diagnostic quality remain unvalidated.
views.baselineComparison: Material correction: crop of the corrected AV root plane; magnification remains linked to the same physical section.

views.observedAnatomy: Basal/right-heart chambers adjacent to a central root-like lumen; some thin internal structures.
views.qualification: Target unconfirmed: broad neighborhood plausible, but a specific TV short-axis plane is not established.

views.observedAnatomy: Longitudinal outlet/pulmonary-region lumen with a narrowing and thin tissue near its ventricular junction, plus adjacent ventricular{local-home} tissue. The old isolated ventricular-looking section is gone.
views.qualification: Regional outlet{local-home} topology improved and supported by the independent pulmonary source neighborhood. The source-preserving plane contains the longitudinal continuation. Individual PV cusp identity remains unconfirmed.

views.observedAnatomy: Thick circular LV myocardium, narrow central cavity with discrete internal tissue, and an adjacent RV-like cavity.
views.qualification: Target unconfirmed / refit candidate: section appears ventricular; distinct paired MV leaflets or an en-face mitral opening are not demonstrated.

views.observedAnatomy: Round ventricular section with thick LV wall, collapsed central LV space/internal tissue, and a larger neighboring trabeculated RV-like cavity.
views.qualification: Gross midventricular short-axis topology supported. Individual papillary muscle identities are not confidently assigned.

views.observedAnatomy: A much smaller distal myocardial section with tiny branching/narrow residual cavity spaces.
views.qualification: Gross apical short-axis progression supported; it is not an open normal LV lumen.

views.observedAnatomy: Two elongated ventricular cavity regions separated by thick septum, with basal atrial spaces farther from the apex.
views.qualification: Gross four-chamber-like topology supported. Fixed/collapsed source anatomy limits resemblance to living ultrasound.

views.observedAnatomy: The same biventricular longitudinal pattern with an LV-focused raster crop.
views.qualification: Gross topology supported. The source crop changes; the 3D model camera still shows much of the retained heart.

views.observedAnatomy: A larger thin-walled/trabeculated right-sided cavity and thick-walled narrow LV cavity, with basal chambers.
views.qualification: Gross RV-focused four-chamber-like topology supported; no functional RV assessment is possible.

views.observedAnatomy: Both ventricular regions remain visible, including a narrow longitudinal LV cavity, with a basal root region brought into the section. The LV cavity is retained rather than replaced by nearly solid myocardium.
views.qualification: Broad chamber/outflow topology improved by aiming toward the independently annotated LV outflow-region guide. This preserves the useful LV cavity; the guide is distinct from the more superior aortic cusp-region ROI. Complete living five-chamber proportions, individual cusps and fine LVOT continuity remain unvalidated.

views.observedAnatomy: At 2 degrees posterior tilt, ventricular cavity tracks and AV continuity remain, with broad atrial spaces. The thin right-heart cavity is narrower than the unchanged A4C.
views.qualification: Posterior four-chamber approximation improved. The coronary-sinus lumen is still unconfirmed; the preset must retain its posterior-angulation qualification.

views.observedAnatomy: A single dominant elongated LV cavity with internal trabecular/papillary-like tissue and basal atrial-region spaces.
views.qualification: Gross two-chamber-like topology supported. Small basal lumen identities remain unconfirmed.

views.observedAnatomy: Similar longitudinal LV cavity/internal tissue in a tighter raster crop.

views.observedAnatomy: Narrow longitudinal LV cavity, basal atrial space, and an elongated root/outflow-like lumen; adjacent right-heart tissue remains visible.

views.observedAnatomy: Same long-axis/outflow arrangement with a closer LV raster crop.
views.qualification: Gross topology supported with the same limits as `a3c`.

views.qualification: Target unconfirmed: atrial tissue/spaces are present, but no pulmonary vein ostium is independently identifiable.

limitations: Not a browser screenshot or browser performance measurement.
Resident source spacing 317.6 µm; this is not a fine/Ultra/native-resolution surface.
Local fine replacement meshes/exclusions are omitted together; baseline donor source-support cleanup is applied. Reviewed lumen masks apply only to LADAF.
Illustrative body/instruments are fixed references, not clinically registered patient anatomy.
No clinical correspondence validation is inferred from geometric coplanarity.

inspectionHistory.method: Four priority pairs and their raw CT rasters opened separately at native size; all52 other complete pairs and their available complete source rasters displayed in26 two-view inspection plates, preserving aspect and without cropping. PLAX AV pair additionally opened at native size. Every current view was inspected; unchanged hashes were not substituted for inspection.

Each of the three changed full paired-anchor images and complete measured source PNGs was opened separately. Hash comparison confirmed every other pair and available source PNG identical to its prior direct inspection.
